title: Split a command line
hints: Two passes make the sizes easy: first count the tokens (a token starts wherever a non-delimiter follows a delimiter or the start), then allocate `count + 1` pointers, the extra one for the terminating `NULL`.

In the second pass, find each token's start and length, `malloc(len + 1)`, `memcpy` the characters and add `'\0'`. `free_tokens` walks the array until `NULL`, frees each string, then frees the array itself.
If a token allocation fails halfway, free what you already built (`tokens[i] = NULL; free_tokens(tokens);`) and return `NULL`. Store `*count` only at the end, on success.
